description: Maxxus Bellevue 3-Person Near Zero EMF (Under 3MG) FAR Infrared Sauna (Canadian Hemlock) The Maxxus Bellevue 3-Person Near Zero EMF FAR Infrared Sauna delivers premium full-body heat therapy in a spacious cabin built for three.
